page.layout: Two parallel columns of Greek index entries with page references, under the running head INDEX X.; a letter heading "M." sits in the left column before its entries; the signature "Aa 3" stands at the foot right. The left and right edges show the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
page.notes: Greek index entries transcribed from a low-contrast scan; several Greek words and some page references in the left column (λιθώσαντες, λιχμήσας, λαδώκαν, μεταλαδὲναι) are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The second column of the M-section and the right-hand references are reproduced as read. The left-edge text belongs to the adjoining page and is omitted. The printed heading is INDEX X., read as the running head.
